cases.scope: Error-pipe child not ready while GC requested; blocking-read participation failure and separately injected fcntl failure in the unchecked polling candidate. Fixed is a fail-closed configuration obligation, not an applied runtime patch; excludes child cleanup, saved registers, pipe lifetime and scheduling fairness

cases.head: be71ec38aaff06d4c310f5b23d916e3a31e31ca7
cases.scope: Two stripe classes and one completed writer operation; nested source/destination locks can self-deadlock on alias, removing source lock requires exclusive source ownership through private destination publication. Unowned-source control is a conditional counterexample, not a diagnosed PR988 runtime defect; fixed is an ownership obligation, not implemented repair

Observed 9-section small live heap, 131072 words per section and 204808-word reserve; 1/2/4 processors each assign one stack and local heap. Existing processor floor is insufficient for allocation admission. Proposed extra reserve plus one-section headroom; excludes max-heap caps, allocation failure and larger occupied heaps; native cause remains to be tested

One slow-path message; same mutex and POSIX atomic condition wait assumed; old is explicitly split-wait fault injection, NOT an observed source bug. Exhausts sender/receiver scheduling and distinguishes ready-but-not-rescheduled from a lost wake; excludes C weak memory, scheduler fairness and spurious wakes

Four processors, two consecutive tree barriers, ordered child receives/replies and reusable cleared mailboxes; coherent atomic visibility and fixed population assumed. Checks epoch/overwrite safety and absence of terminal dead ends, not scheduler fairness, condition variables, C races or VM resizing; no repair claim

One barrier message on the spin fast path; separate release-only and acquire-only controls; explicit weak-memory visibility abstraction, not an exhaustive C memory model or attribution of reported failures; PR989 supplies context, not this fence fix

Two calls, same or distinct object, no collection/resize/wrap; even atomic counter and per-operation table access require transaction serialization; fixed is a protocol obligation, not an implemented GC-safe lock or attribution of the decoder failure

Conditional strong-key slot-update obligation with two worker orders; missing MEM_ALLOC_KEYS is fault injection, not an observed native flag or diagnosed upstream defect; canonical CAS forwarding abstracted
Six hash-consumer/entry-path combinations followed by up to two moving GCs; decoder-only negative control; abstracts collision handling and Scheme rebuilding, not a C algorithm or unbounded proof
Three bounded stack-marker lifecycles; old also includes the locally observed wrong-function edit, not an upstream startup allegation
Uniformly allocated keys in a Scheme-hash table; pointer rehash must notify the Scheme-level rebuilding path
